summary: Restore the possessive face form foṯe from 75/271
rationale: The supplied 75/271 Turoyo reads matrele foṯe, 'he moistened his face', followed by ḥləqle daqne. Foṯe has the third-person possessive ending; the entry instead gives the unsuffixed noun foṯo. This is an ending difference, not a boundary or stress normalization.
The supplied 10/10 translation has 'frühstückten wir zusammen'. The entry drops t and switches to the present tense after the past-perfect clause 'nachdem ich mich rasiert ... gewaschen hatte'.
